summary: Affidavit of diligent search (for notice to a person whose whereabouts are unknown).
applies: Title 18-C (Maine Uniform Probate Code), effective 2019-09-01 — see transition_18a.

governing.title: Notice
governing.why: Notice requirements; this affidavit documents diligent efforts before alternative notice.

considerations.title: Notice
considerations.note: Identifies the person who must receive notice but cannot be located.

considerations.title: Notice
considerations.note: Reasonable diligence (internet, family, government inquiries) supports notice by publication if needed.

transition_18a: Procedural form under current Title 18-C and the Maine Rules of Probate Procedure; the date-of-death substantive transition rules are generally not implicated, though the underlying estate or guardianship matter carries its own transition posture.
